output.body: Isomorph: sum_to(n) equals 1+2+...+n, defined as sum_to(n) = n + sum_to(n-1) with the base case sum_to(0)=0. Tracing sum_to(3) gives 3 + sum_to(2), then 2 + sum_to(1), then 1 + sum_to(0), and sum_to(0) is reached with no further call, so the chain ends and the values add back up.
